entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I'd like to start a return for a VeloBand I bought recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your full name and the order number, please?
Sure, it's Alex Chen. The order number is VF78-99-B02.
Thank you, Alex. I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse, delivered on January 2nd. To understand better, is there a technical fault with the band, or is the return for a different reason?
No, it works perfectly fine. It's just not really what I was looking for in a tracker. It's a bit more complex than I need, so it's really a matter of preference.

I understand. I'm looking at the return eligibility for this item now. Alex, based on the delivery date, it looks like it's been 23 days. Unfortunately, for the VeloBand Pulse, our return policy has a strict 10-day window. I'm afraid it's now too late to process a refund for this item.
Oh, I see. I thought it was 90 days. Okay, I understand a full refund is off the table, but what about store credit? I'd be happy to use it on some other gear from your site.

I appreciate you asking, but the return window applies to all forms of reimbursement, including store credit. The policy is in place for health and safety reasons. After this amount of time, we can't accept wearable electronics back due to hygiene concerns.

Right, the hygiene aspect makes sense. I get that. But I barely wore it, it's practically new. Since the policy wasn't what I expected, maybe you could offer a discount code for my next purchase? Say, 25%? It would go a long way to keeping me as a customer.

I do understand your position, and I'm sorry for the frustration. However, the policy is firm and doesn't allow for exceptions or compensation in this situation. The reason is tied directly to sanitation protocols for items that have skin contact. Once it passes that window, we cannot re-certify the product for any purpose.
So there's absolutely nothing that can be done? No partial credit, no discount, nothing?

I'm afraid not. The system will not allow me to override this specific policy. While it's not a solution from us directly, many of our customers who find themselves in a similar situation have had good luck selling their devices on the VeloFit Resale Marketplace online. Since it's in great condition, you could likely recoup most of its value there.
The resale marketplace... I hadn't thought of that. Okay, it's not ideal, but I guess it's an option. Thanks for the suggestion, Sarah.
You're welcome, Alex. I'm sorry I couldn't provide the outcome you were hoping for today. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's all. Thanks for your time.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
